AI Didn’t Come to Play

Client
Tech 4 Good Africa
Year
2026
Goal
Announce the July AI theme and the AI Impact Opinion Series dates
Deliverables
Event poster · Launch post

A poster and launch post for T4GA’s July focus on AI’s impact across Africa. The poster sets a human profile against a robot’s, with a black and orange headline and speech-bubble tags for healthcare, education and agriculture.

02

Strategic Leadership Forum 2.0

Client
Tech 4 Good Africa
Goal
Build awareness and attendance for the forum
Deliverables
Carousel · Speaker lineup · Countdown series

Promotional set for T4GA’s forum on using technology to address social challenges in Africa. A green and chess-piece visual system carries an explainer carousel, a speaker lineup and a countdown series that steps down from 18 hours to five minutes before the forum went live.

03

Programmes & Partnerships

Client
Tech 4 Good Africa
Goal
Announce a new programme and a new partnership to the community
Deliverables
Programme post · Partnership post

Two announcement posts sharing a light green base, circuit-line texture and a title-first layout. One introduces the Green Incubator, incubating 12 ESG-driven projects; the other announces a partnership with A4S.

04

Valentine’s Day

Client
Tech 4 Good Africa
Year
February 2024
Goal
Keep the community engaged with a warm, on-brand seasonal message
Deliverables
Seasonal card

An oversized numeral sits behind a hand-held bouquet, in a coral and cream palette. The message invites people to step away from tech for a day and share flowers, with a note to choose organic over plastic.

06

Sunday Service Promos

Client
Christ Arrival International Church, Gethsemane Parish
Goal
Invite the congregation to weekly service
Deliverables
Instagram post · Instagram story

Weekly service invitations built on a single image of an open Bible. The post pairs tracked capitals with a heavy serif for a calm, high-contrast look; the story uses a large italic serif over a softly blurred background.
